headline: Is Illinois Tool Works (ITW) Fully Valued Heading Into Its July 28 Earnings?
summary: Illinois Tool Works (ITW) heads into its second quarter 2026 earnings release on July 28, with investors focused on whether its broad industrial portfolio can support projected earnings of $2.80 per share on revenue of $4.18 billion. See our latest analysis for Illinois Tool Works. Illinois Tool Works shares have moved steadily higher into the earnings date, with a 30 day share price return of 7.33% and a year to date share price return of 13.43%.
